semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, hybrid cost, starting loyalty, static restriction and ordered minus-one definition.
Actual hybrid payments and mill before all opposing graveyards are exiled.
A controller's milled cards remain in their own graveyard.
Short and empty libraries mill only available cards before the exile.
The loyalty ability continues after its physical source leaves.
A departed sole target prevents both instructions from resolving.
An actual mandatory search is skipped with no private picker or search trigger, while its shuffle occurs.
Solemn's forbidden optional search is not offered and does not shuffle.
Actual Boseiju channel distinguishes the ability controller from the player searching.
Blocked Gifts binds an empty cohort and reaches its independent shuffle tail.
An empty library does not produce a picker or false search event when the search is prohibited.
Hand and graveyard scopes remain available; a Hand-only search does not shuffle.
Labeled synthetic suppression, control changes and a moved source exercise live static and captured ability controller; allowed failure-to-find still triggers and shuffles.
A synthetically activated restriction invalidates a previously offered actual Solemn branch while preserving decline.
A real Wilds search started before synthetic Ashiok placement completes and fires its observer.
An opponent's actual Opt Scry and draw remain available without a search event.
Accepted wire commands deterministically replay a blocked search, shuffle and subsequent action.
An actual Forgemaster search and Sculpting Steel entry choice finish after synthetic Ashiok placement and unrelated departure.
Actual Tutor and a synthetically designated commander preserve the owner choice, or cleanly retire it when the searcher departs.
Unrestricted Hand and graveyard searches do not shuffle; a Library search that finds nothing shuffles and fires its observer.
A blocked typed Fabled Passage search binds an empty land result and completes its real four-land Untap branch without touching another land.
